major.name: King Stephen of Blois
major.title: King of England
major.notes: Prone to releasing dangerous enemies who should be imprisoned. Popular with soldiers. Struggles with administrative decisions.

major.name: Empress Matilda
major.title: Lady of the English
major.notes: Never forgave England for not simply accepting her as queen. Her manner alienated London when she had it in her grasp.

major.name: Robert of Gloucester
major.title: Earl of Gloucester
major.notes: Matilda's half-brother and the engine of her cause. His capture and exchange is the pivot of the war.

major.name: Henry of Blois
major.title: Bishop of Winchester
major.notes: Stephen's own brother. Will switch sides if the wind changes. Controls Winchester — controls the treasury.

major.name: Geoffrey de Mandeville
major.title: Earl of Essex
major.notes: The war's greatest opportunist. Extracted charters from both sides. Will plunder Ely and the fens when finally cornered.

major.name: Ranulf of Chester
major.title: Earl of Chester
major.notes: His seizure of Lincoln castle triggers the Battle of Lincoln — a pivotal moment.

major.name: Queen Matilda of Boulogne
major.title: Queen Consort
major.notes: The real political operator of Stephen's cause. Organized resistance when Stephen was captured at Lincoln.

major.name: King David I of Scotland
major.title: King of Scots
major.notes: Matilda's uncle. Invaded northern England three times. His army was routed at the Battle of the Standard, 1138.
